payload.title: M5: Access and abuse protection
payload.description: Intent: As the maintainer, I want only the student (and tutor) to be able to start sessions, so that strangers cannot run code or run up the bill. Includes: authentication on the control and proxy endpoints, per-session token, limits on concurrent sessions and session length, AWS Budget alarm. Excludes: multi-tenant signup. DoD: unauthenticated requests are refused; a second concurrent session is refused; budget alarm exists.
